tagline: Three sides to lean on and an open front, so getting in and out stays easy.
lead: Your dog walks straight in through the open front and settles against three cushioned sides, with no wall to step over.
value: Two layers of foam, where many beds have one or none, in a shape a stiffer, older dog can still use.
intro: Rowan is a memory foam bolster dog bed: memory foam over an egg-crate layer, bolsters on three sides, an open front, a fleece sleeping surface, a zipped removable cover and a non-slip base.
points: No wall to step over, so going to bed and getting up again costs them nothing.
A chin rest and a back rest, with soft fleece to lie on between them.
Memory foam for contour over egg-crate foam for support.
A non-slip base underneath, and a zipped cover that comes off to wash.
best_for: Older or stiffer dogs, and any dog who pauses at the wall of an enclosed bed but still likes something to lean on.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm; the bolsters take up part of the outside. Ask us for the exact measurements and whether it fits.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Memory Foam Bolster Dog Bed for Older Dogs | Snoozly
seo_description: A memory foam bolster dog bed with three sides to lean on and an open front, so older dogs can walk straight in. Two foam layers, fleece, zipped cover.
